title_sq: Tek Ambasada Amerikane, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Tek Ambasada Amerikane, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Hapsira Te Bollshme !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet ne korridorin shperndares, sallonin e ndenjes me kend gatimi si me vete, dhoma e gjumit me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. title_en: At the American Embassy, ​​1+1 apartment for sale, with ample space!!
description_en: At the American Embassy, ​​1+1 apartment for sale, with ample spaces!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator and is organized in a distribution corridor, a living room with a separate kitchen, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. The area in which the apartment is located is among the elite both for housing and for investment, as the demand for rent is high. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
